channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Luke Walton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Luke Walton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Harrison Barnes on Luke Walton
item.description:
“One time in Cleveland I did it on a break, and like three people ran by, and [former Kings coach] Luke Walton was assistant coach at the time and was screaming for a travel,”

Harrison Barnes on Luke Walton, Feb 21, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Luke Walton, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Luke Walton's scheme vs Curry tonight after the 62-pointer:

“I'm expecting something crazy from Luke tonight. Box-and-1, triangle-and-two. I don't know.”

Steve Kerr on Luke Walton, Stephen Curry, Jan 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Kent Bazemore on Luke Walton
item.description:
Kings guardKent Bazemore on coach Luke Walton:

“He’s just as fiery as any coach I’ve ever played with. Sometimes it looks like he wants to get out there (and play), but he’s kind of chubby now so those days are over.”

Kent Bazemore on Luke Walton, Feb 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Luke Walton
item.description:
In a game the Mavericks controlled most of the night, Walton versus Dončić was the most compelling part of a second half dominated by the Mavs.

“(Walton) said something I didn’t like about me. That was just it,”

Luka Doncic on Luke Walton, Feb 13, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Luke Walton
item.description:
Jason Jones:De'Aaron Fox:

“We want to pick our pace up. We’ve talked about it. We’ve practiced doing those types of things. We just have to translate it. (Walton) wants us to pick the pace up. We just have to be able to do that.”

De'Aaron Fox on Luke Walton, Dec 31, 2019. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: LeBron James on Luke Walton
item.description:
LeBron James on his year with Luke Walton, who returns to Staples Center tonight with the Kings:

“I think he did as great of a job as he could do under the circumstances.”

LeBron James on Luke Walton, Nov 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on LeBron James, Luke Walton
item.description:
“With LeBron, they gave us some troubles last year, and they really took it to us with that core. I thought Luke Walton did a really good job, I got to say that. I thought he did a really good job his entire tenure there ... But with the Lakers, with LeBron, you got a chance at a championship.”

Andre Iguodala on LeBron James, Luke Walton, Jun 21, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Luke Walton
item.description:
Magic Johnson on what he would've done differently w/ #Lakers:

“I would've hired my own people from the beginning. The one thing I didn't get to do is hire everybody that wanted. Rob [Pelinka] & I got put together. I inherited Luke Walton, so I didn't get to hire my own people.”

Magic Johnson on Luke Walton, May 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Mike Bass on Luke Walton
item.description:
A statement from NBA spokesman Mike Bass on the allegations against Luke Walton:

“We are coordinating with the Kings organization and are in the process of gathering more information.”

Mike Bass on Luke Walton, Apr 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Luke Walton
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Kerr on Luke Walton getting Kings job:

“I’m happy for Luke. That was quick ... it’s a hell of an opportunity for him.”

Steve Kerr on Luke Walton, Apr 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.

item.title: Mike Muscala on Luke Walton
item.description:
Bill Oram:Muscala:

“I really enjoyed playing for Coach Walton, he's a really great guy. He knows his stuff.”

Mike Muscala on Luke Walton, Apr 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Luke Walton
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Rajon Rondo on Luke Walton:

“I think Luke did a hell of a job with what he had, the cards he was dealt. Them guys fought every night.”

Rajon Rondo on Luke Walton, Apr 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Michael Beasley on Luke Walton
item.description:
Beasley, in addressing the situation for the first time, denies it was such a heated incident.

“This past Saturday after the Warriors game, Coach Walton and our team had a conversation after a tough loss. Despite reports to the contrary, there was nothing physical between Coach Walton, me, or any other teammate,”

Michael Beasley on Luke Walton, Feb 5, 2019. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: LeBron James on Luke Walton
item.description:
LeBron James on fight:

“I didn't see anything. I didn't say anything to my team after the game. Coach [Walton] said what he had to say. We'll come in tomorrow and get better.”

LeBron James on Luke Walton, Oct 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Luke Walton
item.description:
Bill Oram:Rob Pelinka on Luke Walton:

“We think our roster and its strength actually lines up perfectly with our coach and his strengths.”

Rob Pelinka on Luke Walton, Sep 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Luke Walton
item.description:
Jeanie Buss:

“Coach Luke Walton has done a great job getting everyone to buy into what his vision is, and so now we have an identity”

Jeanie Buss on Luke Walton, Aug 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Luke Walton
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on Luke Walton:

“Luke has an ability to connect with people like I've never seen. He can disarm any group of people. People want to play for him. They want to please him.”

Jeanie Buss on Luke Walton, Aug 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on LeBron James, Luke Walton
item.description:
Said Rob Pelinka:

“We’re really excited about camp this year because Luke (Walton) has decided... we’re going to have an incredibly competitive camp and all the spots are going to be open spots, putting aside LeBron James, obviously.”

Rob Pelinka on LeBron James, Luke Walton, Jul 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @Mike_Bresnahan.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Luke Walton
item.description:
Jamal Murray on crowd reaction tonight:

“I don’t let other people get under my skin. I just play the game. I’m used to trash talking. I used to watch Kobe in this very arena play, playing with Luke Walton. So I see where Luke got it from. I love playing w/that competitiveness”

Jamal Murray on Luke Walton, Mar 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Luke Walton, LaVar Ball
item.description:
Larry Nance Jr. on LaVar Ball’s negative comments about Luke Walton and whether they discuss it as a team:

“I mean, every now and again [we talk about it], but it’s more so just in passing. It’s not like we’re ever sitting around like, ‘What are we going to do about this?!’ No. He’s a grown man and he can say what he wants. Luke is a grown man and he can deal with it. We’re all grown men, individually. As players, it’s not necessarily our job to deal with it, worry about it or even think about it. We pretty much leave it alone. Of course we all see it, but he’s got the right to an opinion just like everybody else does.”

Larry Nance Jr on Luke Walton, LaVar Ball, Jan 27, 2018. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Luke Walton
item.description:
Larry Nance Jr. on the job Luke Walton is doing and whether there’s anything to the suggestion that he has lost the locker room, as LaVar said:

“I think Luke is great. What you hear about a lot of NBA coaches is that they’re bad at communicating and stuff and he’s the _total_ opposite. He’s always pulling guys aside [to help us], talking to us and getting out in front of any potential problems that may arise. I love him as a head coach. I think he’s great, and I think he’s going to be great. I stand firm in my belief in him.”

Larry Nance Jr on Luke Walton, Jan 27, 2018. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Luke Walton
item.description:
Bill Oram:Pop on LaVar criticizing Luke Walton:

“I think the first thing to do is look at the substance and gravitas of the source that speaks. Stopping at that point would tell you you don’t need to go any further. It’s just another fan from the peanut gallery.”

Gregg Popovich on Luke Walton, Jan 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Luke Walton, Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Fred Hoiberg on Rick Carlisle’s words:

“I think it’s great. Rick as the president of the coaches association, sticking up for a fellow coach. Knowing Luke Walton... I think he’s a hell of a coach and he’s doing a great job.”

Fred Hoiberg on Luke Walton, Rick Carlisle, Jan 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Luke Walton
item.description:
“Printing an article where the father of an NBA player has an opinion that is printed as anything like legitimate erodes trust. It erodes the trust that we've built with ESPN, and our coaches are upset, because Luke Walton does not deserve that.”

Rick Carlisle on Luke Walton, Jan 7, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Luke Walton
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Kobe Bryant on Luke Walton:

“He’s very patient. Very studious. He can see things 3 moves ahead. I can go to Luke w/ a very complicated scheme & he’d pick it up immediately. He’s ability to recognize situations & understand the game, & in turn how to communicate.”

Kobe Bryant on Luke Walton, Dec 8, 2017. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Corey Brewer on Luke Walton
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Brewer on Luke Walton:

“Luke’s great. He’s a great coach, man. He knows (how to talk to players) and he knows X’s and O’s.”

Corey Brewer on Luke Walton, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Julius Randle on Luke Walton
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Randle on playing for Luke Walton:

“It was amazing. He just came in every day and brought an energy and a vibe that I’ve never experienced.”

Julius Randle on Luke Walton, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Thomas Robinson on Luke Walton
item.description:
Serena Winters:Thomas Robinson:

“Even when I wasn’t playing, Luke (Walton) gave me attention as if I was a starter.”

Thomas Robinson on Luke Walton, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Thomas Robinson on Luke Walton
item.description:
Serena Winters:Thomas Robinson on Luke Walton:

“I think for this group of young players, there could be nobody better than Luke.”

Thomas Robinson on Luke Walton, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Tyler Ennis on Luke Walton
item.description:
Serena Winters:Tyler Ennis:

“I just loved playing for him (Luke Walton) and I love playing for the Lakers.”

Tyler Ennis on Luke Walton, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.
